load_ytvis_json: load YTVIS JSON annotations into Detectron2 dict format from a json file and image root directory
register_ytvis_instances: register a YTVIS dataset with Detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog for instance tracking
get_ytvis_2019_meta: get metadata dict with thing classes, colors, and id mapping for YTVIS 2019 categories
get_ytvis_2021_meta: get metadata dict with thing classes, colors, and id mapping for YTVIS 2021 categories
get_imagenet_cls_agnostic_meta: get class-agnostic foreground metadata dict with single fg category for ImageNet-style datasets
